Imported Draftmango design: fashion-store-3. Preserve its layout and styling. Editable React pages; shared CSS and imagery at https://draftmango.com/draftmango/.

Demo claims, contact details and products must be reviewed before publishing. Forms, checkout, accounts and other backend features need integration. Keep vendor runtime files intact.
